packageRules.description: Low-risk update types merge without a human. `autoApprove` is deliberately NOT set: Renovate is always the last pusher on its own branch, so main-ruleset's require_last_push_approval voids any review it submits itself. The approving review comes from .github/workflows/renovate-auto-approve.yml, which acts as github-actions[bot] once run-linter and run-unit-tests pass. The `automerge-safe` label is the gate that workflow checks — it approves nothing without it, so removing this rule disables auto-approval rather than widening it.
Major bumps are never auto-approved. Labelling them keeps them out of the automerge-safe set, lets renovate-auto-approve.yml skip them, and makes the human-review queue easy to filter.

Non-major Python updates get one randomly-sampled reviewer for visibility. These auto-merge once CI is green (see renovate-auto-approve.yml), so the assignment is a notification, not a gate. Mirrors arthur-engine's pep621 minor/patch rule; all three are active arthur-common contributors.
Route major Python bumps to the backend experts for human review. No reviewersSampleSize, so both are always requested — majors are never auto-approved, so this assignment IS the gate.
